//: EI-11021: the automatic JSX runtime (jsx: react-jsx) must live in the package tsconfig, not only in vitest.config.ts's esbuild override. These components (and their tests) omit `import React` and rely on the automatic runtime; Vite/esbuild reads jsx from the nearest tsconfig whenever a run does NOT explicitly set esbuild.jsx. Without this, any vitest invocation that uses the base @papercusp/test-config (no esbuild.jsx override) transformed the JSX to classic React.createElement and every test failed intermittently with `React is not defined`. The vitest.config.ts override remains as a belt; this tsconfig is the config-path-independent fix.
